The '''Scrap Pit''' was an area of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]<ref name="MekSha" /> in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> It was used by the [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] group [[The Brothers]] to house some of their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Dash">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|A Dash of Kindness|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref>
